item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera connects a small electric cell to make a torch bulb glow at home. She notices that one end of the cell has a raised metal cap and the other end is a flat metal disc.
Which statement about the cell is correct?

options.A: The flat metal disc is the positive terminal and the raised metal cap is the negative terminal; the cell pushes electric current around the circuit.
options.B: The raised metal cap is the positive terminal and the flat metal disc is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
options.C: Either end of the cell can be the positive terminal, so the cell can be connected any way round to run the circuit.
options.D: Both ends of the cell are negative terminals; the cell stores electrical energy but cannot push current around a circuit.
